name: ai-office
description: A cozy 3D office where every AI coding agent running on your machine is a chibi worker at a desk.

scripts.test: node --test test/week.test.mjs test/claude-collector.test.mjs test/codex-collector.test.mjs test/links.test.mjs test/artifact.test.mjs test/delegation.test.mjs test/midnight.test.mjs test/director.test.mjs test/sun.test.mjs test/openings.test.mjs test/jobs.test.mjs test/origin.test.mjs test/autoquality.test.mjs test/open.test.mjs && node scripts/test-hudfit.mjs
scripts.lint: bash scripts/lint-chained-add.sh && bash scripts/lint-comment-swallow.sh && for f in web/*.js server/*.js server/collectors/*.js server/links/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
